title: MedicationOrderShared
description: A doctor's signed medication order was shared with a Nurse-edition tenant through Kiorex consent (a nurse may only administer against a doctor's order, BR57; MAR checks are never a flag). Carries the signed order version, expiry and a secure link only: medicine lines, doses and clinical text are never embedded.

toClinicId.description: Receiving Nurse-edition tenant (organization of one for a solo nurse).

patientRef.description: Kiorex subject or Kiorly patient reference; never a national ID.

consentToken.description: Opaque token derived from the patient's active record-share grant (rsc_...).

aggregateType.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.

aggregateId.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.
